residency_requirement: Indian resident; treatment in India only
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani product; 15 days grace for half-yearly/quarterly/monthly, 30 days for annual

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to sum insured + cumulative bonus
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani indemnity cover

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care treatments covered up to sum insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Where hospitalization is not possible / no room available

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs. 2,000 per hospitalization (road ambulance)

room_rent_capping: Up to 2% of sum insured subject to maximum Rs. 5,000/day (SI ≤ Rs. 5L); Rs. 10,000/day (SI Rs. 6-10L); Rs. 20,000/day (SI Rs. 15-20L)
icu_capping: Up to 5% of sum insured subject to maximum Rs. 10,000/day (SI ≤ Rs. 5L); Rs. 20,000/day (SI Rs. 6-10L); Rs. 40,000/day (SI Rs. 15-20L)
copayment_trigger_notes: Mandatory 5% co-payment on all admissible claims (standard Arogya Sanjeevani feature)

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: 25% of sum insured or Rs. 40,000 per eye in one policy year, whichever is lower
disease_wise_sub_limits.modern_treatments: Up to 50% of sum insured for all listed modern treatments combined

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Cover restricted to treatment taken in India

notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani product — maternity, cosmetic surgery, infertility, refractive error, weight-control treatments and out-of-India treatment all excluded. Mandatory 5% co-payment on every claim.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Oriental Insurance network hospitals through TPA when opted; reimbursement claims processed by policy issuing office/TPA.
